species:S14@1.mechanism: A new-high breakout that closes back below the breakout level traps late buyers who chased the print; their supply overhang suppresses subsequent rally attempts. The failed-breakout pattern identifies names whose breakout has reversed intrabar or within 1-3 sessions, leaving the majority of late entrants underwater. This is a top/entry-veto-shaped context for de-escalation or new-position avoidance — NOT a short-selling signal. The supply overhang typically resolves as: (a) time washout (late buyers capitulate) or (b) re-test of the breakout level on improved breadth. Mechanism link: the Wave-5 retest_hold study confirmed that a retest of the prior high WITHOUT breakout failure predicts continuation; the complement (WITH failure) predicts elevated drawdown risk.
